what_a_reader_should_see: This is the same defect as example 02, with one field changed: the signing time is moved to after execution. The rule now reads the record as a post-hoc audit and passes it. This is the hole the repository documents rather than closes.

record.note: execution was at 16:00; the signing time now reads 16:20

why: Signed after execution, so the act type is derived as a post-hoc audit, and a post-hoc audit is permitted to name the executed version. Nothing in the record can refute the signing time it carries, so no schema change closes this. It needs a time source the record's author cannot rewrite.
